page.overview:
What is Ammathtar?

Ammathtar was a city located in northeastern Dambrath,

Ammathtar was located between the Granuin forest on the east and the Trader's Way on the west.

Foreign travelers entering Ammathtar, including all adventurers, had to bribe an official with 100 gp each in order to enter the city. Prices for goods was discounted for crinti but inflated for every other race. A small percentage of all business transactions when to the city coffers, helping to fund a strong army.

The largest horse pens in all of Dambrath were found in Ammathtar, holding upward of 5,000 prized steeds.
